article.title: Two tankers carrying Saudi oil attacked in Strait of Hormuz
article.summary: By Florence TanSINGAPORE, Sept 1 (Reuters) - Two supertankers carrying Saudi oil were struck by unknown projectiles within minutes of each other while transiting outbound through the Strait of Hormuz late on Monday, according to shipping intelligence and tracking firms Marisks and Kpler."The near-simultaneous incidents represent a further escalation in the threat environment within the Omani corridor," Marisks said.

article.title: Strait of Hormuz commodity vessel transits stay in single digits, data shows
article.summary: SINGAPORE, Sept 1 (Reuters) - The number of vessels sailing through the Strait of Hormuz was little changed on Monday compared with the weekend, hovering around five, preliminary ship-tracking data showed on Tuesday, below the 10-day average of around 14.Four of the vessels entered the strait and one exited, data from Kpler showed.Vessels that sail through the strait with their transponders turned off are not included in the count.No liquid tankers were among those sailing through the waterway on Monday, the data showed.

article.title: Oil Flowing Through the Strait
article.summary: The Trump administration has been saying for a while that as many as nine million barrels of oil a day are traversing the Strait of Hormuz. That claim has been “fact checked” and derided by just about everyone. Politico is one of many instances: “Trump’s rosy Hormuz claims collide with tanker data.” Energy Secretary Chris Wright says about 9 million barrels of oil are moving through the Strait of Hormuz
